content_zh:
一名不足四十岁，厚重有威的中年人，正在庭院中走来走去。
这只是内书房前一个供主人散步的庭院而已，已经阔大有数十丈方圆。从已经灭亡数年的陈朝运来的江南石木，在这关中之地，却装点出一座颇有江左风流意味的小苑。
大隋虽然立国已久，且一统天下。但江南在晋后之世，富庶繁华已经压倒了久经丧乱的中原。现下每年堆积在洛口黎阳等仓的粮食绢段，基本都是从江南输送而来，供应着大隋的腹心关中关东之地。
而承自晋时的风流况味，也让北方口中不说，心下也倾慕不已。
能在寸土寸金的长安都城，经营处这么大一个宅邸，并将内书房前庭院装点出完全江南味道。主人权势富贵，可见一斑。
但这位看起来厚重有威的庭院主人，现下却是一脸焦躁之色。
门外传来脚步响动之声，一名带着兜鍪，披着明光铠的军将，正大步而入。来到主人面前，禀手一礼。
中年人早就迎了上来：“情势如何？”
那军将压低声音：“越国公亲自坐镇，十二卫宿卫精锐尽数选调而出，就在今夜，大洗东宫。废太子已然移出东宫。”
中年人浑身一震：“东宫宿卫呢？”
军将声音更低：“末将身在其中，已然奉越国公命尽数将宿卫诛杀。”
中年人似乎松了一口气，又颤声问道：“徐卫一家……”
军将语调毫无起伏，平平道：“左屯卫宿卫东宫郎将徐卫一家，闭门自焚，绝无孑遗。”
中年人神色终于平静了下来，摇头道：“可惜了徐卫，一表人才，临阵无敌。但却跟错了人，这份忠心，当真用错了地方。”
军将语声仍然平平淡淡：“但徐卫此前，已经将出生未久的孩子交给了旧左卫府司马，他的父亲徐敢。徐敢今夜，已然出长安去了……不知可要追么？”
中年人下意识的举起手来，最后颓然一叹：“徐敢旧从先祖，所向有功。我不能保他儿子一门，现下就让他去罢……可知道他的去向？”
军将神情终于有了点变化：“徐敢当年是老柱国麾下虎将，单人独骑曾渡河深入北齐军中哨探，携北齐军中七将首级而返。他真要走，末将如何追得上他？”
中年人沉吟半晌，最后摇头：“罢了，以徐敢本事，当能无恙。随他去罢！”
夜色之中，一名五十许的老人，正策马持槊疾疾而驰。
长安雄伟城墙，在他身后，已经只是一条淡淡的黑线。

在他身前，系着一个襁褓。老人一边催马疾走，一边不时低头看去。
襁褓之中，是一个雪白粉嫩的八九个月大婴儿，正吃着自己手指头。战马颠簸，这婴儿却没有半天要哭闹的样子，老人低头，这婴儿还回一个大大的笑容。
泪水从老人眼眶中滑落下来，又被他一把擦去。
“又是徐家的一个将种！将来比你爹爹还强！”
接着老人又浩叹一声，悲愤之气，在这一叹之中充塞茫茫四野！
“可是就算如你爹爹一般的本事，又能有何用？在世家眼中，我们的性命，再轻贱不过！爷爷只要你好好活着，爷爷也会一直保护着你好好活着！”
夜色之中，老人婴儿，单马独槊。却茫然不知去路。
小婴儿在老人怀中手舞足蹈，突然指向北方，呀呀的不知道在说些什么。
老人向北望去，长叹一声：“那就向北而去罢！”

content_en:
A thick and imposing middle-aged man, less than forty years old, was walking around in the courtyard.
This is just a courtyard in front of the inner study room for the owner to walk. It is already dozens of feet wide. The stones and wood from the south of the Yangtze River brought from the Chen Dynasty, which had been extinct for several years, decorated a small garden in this Guanzhong area with a sense of Jiangzuo romance.
Although the Sui Dynasty had been established for a long time, it had unified the world. But in the post-Jin Dynasty, Jiangnan's prosperity had overwhelmed the Central Plains, which had long been in chaos. Nowadays, the grain and silk pieces accumulated in warehouses such as Luokou and Liyang every year are basically transported from the south of the Yangtze River to supply the Guanzhong and Guandong lands in the heart of the Sui Dynasty.
And the romantic atmosphere inherited from the Jin Dynasty also made the north admire him, not only in his mouth, but also in his heart.
Being able to operate such a large mansion in the capital city of Chang'an, where every inch of land is at a premium, and decorate the courtyard in front of the inner study to give it a complete Jiangnan feel. The master's power and wealth are evident.
But the owner of the courtyard, who looked dignified and dignified, now looked anxious.
There was the sound of footsteps outside the door, and a general with a robe and bright armor was striding in. When he comes to his master, he bows his hand.
The middle-aged man had already greeted him: "How is the situation?"
The military general lowered his voice: "The Duke of Yue is personally in charge, and all the elite guards of the twelve guards have been selected. Tonight, the East Palace will be cleaned. The deposed prince has already moved out of the East Palace."
The middle-aged man was shocked: "Where are the guards in the East Palace?"
The general's voice was even lower: "The last general is among them, and he has already killed all the guards under the orders of the Duke of Yue."
The middle-aged man seemed to be relieved and asked in a trembling voice: "Xu Wei's family..."
The general's tone was smooth and he said flatly: "The family of Xu Wei, the general of the Zuotun Guards and the general of the East Palace, set himself on fire behind closed doors. There are no survivors."
The middle-aged man's expression finally calmed down, he shook his head and said, "It's a pity that Xu Wei is a talented person and invincible in battle. But he followed the wrong person, and his loyalty was really used in the wrong place."
The general's voice was still calm: "But Xu Wei had already handed over his newborn child to his father, Xu Gan, Sima of the old Zuowei Mansion. Xu Gan left Chang'an tonight... Do you want to pursue him?"
The middle-aged man raised his hands subconsciously, and finally sighed dejectedly: "Xu Gan followed his ancestors and served his purpose well. I can't protect his son, so I'll just let him go now... Do you know where he is going?"
The general's expression finally changed a little: "Xu Gan was a tiger general under the command of Lao Zhuguo. He once crossed the river and went deep into the Northern Qi Army's outposts on horseback, and returned with the heads of seven generals in the Northern Qi Army. If he really wants to leave, how can the general catch up with him?"
The middle-aged man pondered for a long time, and finally shook his head: "That's all, with Xu Gan's ability, he should be fine. Just let him go!"
In the darkness of the night, an old man in his fifties was riding a horse and galloping with a spear in hand.
The majestic city wall of Chang'an was just a faint black line behind him.
In front of him was a swaddling clothes tied. The old man urged the horse to gallop away, looking down from time to time.
Among the swaddling clothes, there was a snow-white and tender eight or nine-month-old baby, eating from his own finger. The horse jolted, but the baby didn't look like he was going to cry for a long time. The old man lowered his head, and the baby smiled back.
Tears fell from the old man's eyes and were wiped away by him.
"Another general from the Xu family! He will be stronger than your father in the future!"
Then the old man sighed again, filled with grief and anger, filling the vast surrounding area!
"But even if you are as capable as your father, what's the use? In the eyes of the aristocratic family, our lives are nothing more than contempt! Grandpa, as long as you live well, grandpa will always protect you and live well!"
In the night, the old man and the baby were riding alone. But he didn't know the way to go.
The little baby was dancing in the old man's arms, and suddenly pointed to the north, babbling without knowing what he was saying.
The old man looked north and sighed: "Then just go north!"
